cinematic.skyabyss.opening.hero2: A quiet morning. And yet something cold sits at the bottom of my chest.
cinematic.skyabyss.opening.heaven1: The sky has not gone to sleep.
cinematic.skyabyss.opening.heaven2: Follow the smoke. To where people are.
cinematic.skyabyss.opening.goal: Goal: head for the rising smoke
cinematic.skyabyss.whale.hero2: No. That is a living thing.

cinematic.skyabyss.whale.hero3: Something like that, in this sky...
